messages.en: I was born in Ipoh, but I grew up in KL.
Oh, that explains it! I thought you were originally from KL.
Has that review been done yet? I want to send the report to the client this afternoon.
Yes, all the figures have been checked and they're correct. I'll send you the final version in a bit, okay?

collocations.en: can be seen; can be viewed

messages.en: You can view the photo at this link. I sent it earlier.
Oh, I can see it now. Can I save a copy?

senses.en_definition: Where; used to ask or indicate the location of someone or something. The standard spelling is di mana.

messages.en: Where are you? I'm already outside this shoe shop.
I'm still upstairs. Just wait there—I'm coming down now.
